text:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: High 5xx spike on api-prod at 2026-03-15T01:13:09Z — paging adele as primary oncall
adele: seeing 5xx + increased latency. datadog dashboards are mostly empty/old values, panels stuck at 5m ago. :grimacing:
sujay: this looks like DD ingest delay — their status page shows "ingest delays impacting logs & metrics in us-east-1" https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/xyz :confused:
iris: confirmed. our metric tail is frozen; spans and traces show up intermittently. logging team: are fluentd agents still pushing? ops-runner: yes, agents are green locally, just 429s from api.datadoghq.com
samir: quick mitigation plan: 1) lower alert sensitivity to avoid noisy pages 2) switch important dashboards to prometheus direct scrape for now 3) start local buffering/ship to s3 bucket for later ingestion
adele: I'm lowering alert thresholds now in PagerDuty console and muting non-critical routes. doing prometheus scrape switch for critical endpoints (auth, inference-p95) — giving playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/datadog-ingest-delay
ops-runner: command to flip to prometheus-rescue role:
```
kubectl annotate deployment api -n prod telemetry-mode=prometheus-rescue --overwrite
./infra/telemetry/scrape-rescue.sh --targets api-prod
```
iris: started a s3 log-forwarder job to buffer raw logs: job/ldg-buffer-20260315 created
samir: contacting Datadog support (ticket #DD-11234) and posted our customer impact note; they responded that backend is throttling and they are working on backlog
adele: customer impact: external-facing inference gateway had increased 503s for ~6 mins during spike; affected ~4 customers on dedicated capacity (IDs: C-1182, C-3381, C-4477) — product support notified and drafting status update
sujay: triage note: SLA risk flagged for C-1182 (high throughput committed). recommend proactive outreach from SOCAM
ops-runner: started capturing more traces locally to /var/tmp/traces-20260315 and pinned retention x24h
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-007 — severity: sev2 — incident lead: adele
adele: preparing handoff — I'll be on-call for another 28m, then sujay takes over. leaving notes: prometheus scrape enabled, s3 buffer running, DD ticket open, muting noisy alerts, tracking customer comms in INC-20260315 doc
sujay: ack — will monitor metrics and escalate to infra if datadog backlog doesn't clear within 40m. setting reminder @ 02:00 UTC to re-evaluate
pagerduty-bot: Handoff scheduled: adele -> sujay at 02:00 UTC :repeat:
samir: one more ask — add temporary alert that watches for any null/empty dashboard panels and page infra if they occur; those are indicators of vendor-level ingestion issues
adele: noted, adding rule now
iris: small FYI — we saw some delayed logs appear after 9m; latency graphs started catching up slowly. Datadog says backlog draining, still flaky
sujay: thanks team. keeping channel open for next hour. if anything customer-facing escalates, page the oncall-sr team :loud_sound:
samir: leaving a short after-action checklist in the incident doc: root cause (Datadog ingestion throttling), mitigations (prometheus fallback, s3 buffer, mute), customer impact (C-1182 alert), follow-ups (re-run telemetry DR, update runbooks)
adele: handing over now — sujay, taking control. :white_check_mark:
sujay: on it. logging full timeline to INC-20260315. last update here 1903456820
